answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 38045 Country: FR Title: Wigs n human hair Question: I have a cosmetic shop and I sell wigs and human hair. Please, can you clarify if this is allowed? Answer ID: 38045 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 697/376/L=1433) It is lawful to use and sell animal feather and hair: لا باس ببیع عظام المیتۃ وعصبھا وصوفھا وقرنھا وشعرھا ووبرھا والانتفاع بذلک کلہ لانھا طاھرۃ لا یحلھا الموت لعدم الحیاۃ [ھدایۃ 3:55] But it is unlawful to sell the human hair; therefore you must avoid dealing in the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
